description.value: A full-service IGA supermarket serving the Summerland/Naramata area of BC's Okanagan, stocking a wide range of fresh produce, deli, bakery, and packaged goods. Located on Prairie Valley Road, it sits in prime wine country cycling territory and offers a convenient resupply point for touring cyclists exploring the Naramata Bench and Kettle Valley Rail Trail. The store operates as a standard neighbourhood IGA with in-store pickup available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies a full-service IGA supermarket at 7519 Prairie Valley Road tagged as shop=supermarket. The website content, while largely generic IGA BC navigation/department listings, confirms the store carries complete grocery departments including Deli & Prepared Foods and Ready to Eat Meals. No bike-specific amenities (parking, pump, charging) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags. The OSM community field says 'Naramata' but the website URL slug is 'summerland-iga', suggesting a possible community attribution discrepancy worth flagging.
